questions.q: The concept of Miri and Piri was introduced by which Guru?
questions.qPa: ਮੀਰੀ ਅਤੇ ਪੀਰੀ ਦਾ ਸੰਕਲਪ ਕਿਸ ਗੁਰੂ ਦੁਆਰਾ ਪੇਸ਼ ਕੀਤਾ ਗਿਆ ਸੀ?
questions.explanation: Guru Hargobind Ji introduced the two swords of Miri (temporal power) and Piri (spiritual authority).

questions.q: Who constructed the Akal Takht in Amritsar?
questions.explanation: Guru Hargobind Ji constructed the Akal Takht (Throne of the Timeless One) as the center for political affairs.

questions.q: Which Guru is often referred to as 'Bala Pritam'?
questions.explanation: Guru Harkrishan Ji, who became Guru at the age of five, is known as Bala Pritam.

questions.q: What was the original name of Anandpur Sahib?
questions.qPa: ਅਨੰਦਪੁਰ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਦਾ ਅਸਲ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਸੀ?
questions.explanation: Anandpur Sahib was founded by Guru Tegh Bahadur Ji and originally named Chakk Nanaki after his mother.

questions.q: Where was Guru Tegh Bahadur Ji martyred in 1675?
questions.explanation: Guru Tegh Bahadur Ji was publicly executed at Chandni Chowk in Delhi on the orders of Emperor Aurangzeb.

questions.q: In which year was the Khalsa Panth created by Guru Gobind Singh Ji?
questions.qPa: ਗੁਰੂ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਸਿੰਘ ਜੀ ਦੁਆਰਾ ਖਾਲਸਾ ਪੰਥ ਦੀ ਸਾਜਨਾ ਕਿਸ ਸਾਲ ਕੀਤੀ ਗਈ ਸੀ?
questions.explanation: The Khalsa was created on Baisakhi day in the year 1699 at Anandpur Sahib.

questions.q: Which was the first major battle fought by Guru Gobind Singh Ji?
questions.explanation: The Battle of Bhangani (1688) against the hill rajas was the first major battle fought by Guru Gobind Singh Ji.

questions.q: Where did Guru Gobind Singh Ji pass the Guruship to the Guru Granth Sahib?
questions.explanation: In 1708, at Nanded (Maharashtra), Guru Gobind Singh Ji declared the Guru Granth Sahib as the eternal Guru.
